answer.answer: No. The historical accuracy rule (promoting any model when accuracy exceeded 0.80) is no longer an alternative to the F1 gate. The legacy 2024 memo that contained that rule is explicitly marked as superseded and instructs not to apply the old rule. The current governing release policy requires promotion only when F1 improves by at least 0.005 and ROC-AUC drops by no more than 0.01 on a frozen holdout, with no accuracy-based alternative.
